description_en: Queries the information about host specifications
description_zh: 调用DescribeHostEcsLevelInfo查询主机规格详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun cddc describe-host-ecs-level-info --db-type mysql --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id ap-southeast-1a --storage-type local_ssd --image-category AliLinux --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHostEcsLevelInfo

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

mysql

mssql

pgsql

redis
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎类型，取值：

mysql
mssql
pgsql
redis
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198326.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

local_ssd: standard SSD.

cloud_essd: PL1 enhanced SSD (ESSD).

cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD.

cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：

local_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The image of the host. Valid values:

WindowsWithMssqlEntAlwaysonLicense: SQL Server Cluster Edition.

WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense: SQL Server Standard Edition.

WindowsWithMssqlEntLicense: SQL Server Enterprise Edition.

WindowsWithMssqlWebLicense: SQL Server Web Edition.

AliLinux: other images
parameters.help_zh:
主机镜像。取值：

WindowsWithMssqlEntAlwaysonLicense：SQL Server集群版

WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense：SQL Server标准版

WindowsWithMssqlEntLicense：SQL Server企业版

WindowsWithMssqlWebLicense：SQL Server Web版

AliLinux：其他主机镜像
parameters.name: image_category
